newsitem.title: USA: Ascend jumps in heavy trading.
newsitem.headline: Ascend jumps in heavy trading.

text.p: Ascend Communications Corp's share price surged in heavy trading after the Alameda, Calif., company posted strong fourth quarter earnings following the market close Thursday.
The shares jumped 3-1/8 to 72. The maker of Internet switches was the most active stock on the Nasdaq with about 2.0 million shares traded only 30 minutes into the trading session.

Ascend earned $0.32 a share in the fourth quarter, compared with $0.11 a year ago. Smith Barney analysts Therese Murphy raised her rating on the stock to buy, citing continuing strength in the remote data communications market.
